single_shot_60s.global_prompt: integrated_multimodal_description: [One continuous dimly lit intimate drama, two characters] A middle-aged man and woman sit facing each other at a small wooden table in a cramped, warmly lit Chinese city apartment at night. Tension and tenderness alternate as they argue and reconcile in Mandarin dialogue. The scene is photorealistic live-action, shallow depth of field, close medium shots, natural handheld subtlety and no hard cuts within each segment. No subtitles.

[Same shot, continuation] She replies with rising hurt, leaning forward: <d>[Chinese] 那你现在说，我想听。</d> He meets her eyes, a long beat; the same tight framing, warm lamp, and quiet room tone continue, no cut.

[Same shot, continuation] He admits his feelings with a softer voice, reaching for her hand: <d>[Chinese] 我是怕失去你，才一直瞒着。</d> She blinks, expression softening; the shallow focus holds on their faces, same setting and lighting.

[Same shot, continuation] She laughs lightly through the emotion, shaking her head: <d>[Chinese] 你呀，总是把心事藏得那么深。</d> He almost smiles, shoulders easing; their faces and the warm apartment remain identical, dialogue crisp and readable.

[Same shot, continuation] They hold a quiet moment, then he murmurs: <d>[Chinese] 从今往后，我什么都告诉你。</d> She nods, taking his hand; the frame holds as the lamp flickers gently, same two people, same room, no cut, no text.
